key_traits.label: Life cycle
key_traits.text: Annual or short-lived perennial depending on treatment/conditions.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Twining vine with long flexible shoots.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate, large, heart-shaped; often 3-lobed; densely to moderately hairy.

key_traits.label: Sepals
key_traits.text: Usually about 16–17 mm in Williamson County material, lanceolate and hairy.

key_traits.label: Corolla
key_traits.text: Large trumpet-shaped flower, around 5–7 cm or more across/long in local material; often blue-violet aging pinkish.

key_traits.label: Key
key_traits.text: Much larger flower than I. hederacea and I. triloba; hairy foliage and long sepals.
